**Finding: COMPLIANT** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Bluefly, meeting the playbook's preferred position.

What I checked:
- **§ 14.16 Freedom of Action** — works in our favour: "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others."
- **§ 14.11 No Resale** — the only "shall not" binding us; a scope-of-use limit on IBM's own Services, not a restraint on our products or lines of business. Not a non-compete.
- **§ 12.1 License** — routine no-reverse-engineering/copying limit on the Base Components.
- **§ 14.17 Limitation of Licenses** — reciprocal IP provision, not a business restraint.
- **§ 14.19 Geographic Scope** — limits IBM's delivery obligations, not our activities.
- **§ 13.2 AUP** — no covenant limiting our business (though note IBM may modify the AUP on 30 days' notice, which is a separate unilateral-amendment concern outside this rule).

Text searches for "compet*", "shall not develop", "exclusiv*", "minimum" and "Customer shall not" returned nothing restrictive: no exclusivity, no minimum purchase commitment, no territory or field-of-use covenant.
